name: PT Berkah Prima Perkasa Tbk
summary: PT Berkah Prima Perkasa Tbk engages in the trading of printing and related products in Indonesia. It sells printer inks, photo paper, toner, barcode label printer, blueprint pos package, stickers, sticker semi coated, unboxing, sticker label portable, brother, ribbon wax, ID card, printer thermal, thermal papers, Bluetooth barcode scanners, inkjets, transfer paper, laminating films, cash drawers, DTF consumables, wenax t-shirt, hospital patient bracelet, ribbon full resin, sublime printer, and wristband. PT Berkah Prima Perkasa Tbk was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia.
